name: multistorey-measurements-f13
description: v0.31.5.284 visual verification: in the whole-plan orbit view of the two-storey Open Loft, dimension markers + room labels must appear on the UPPER storey lifted to its own elevation (they were ground-only, and this overlay sits outside PlanShell's per-level groups so it must raise its own geometry).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('empty-room-hint'); })()

steps.name: load-loft-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__loadErr=null; import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const plan = m.PLAN_TEMPLATES.find(p => p.id === 'tpl-loft'); if (!plan) throw new Error('tpl-loft missing'); window.__store.getState().replaceFloorPlan(plan, { furniture: 'rehome' }); }).catch(e => { window.__loadErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: measurements-on
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); if (!s.showMeasurements) { s.toggleMeasurements ? s.toggleMeasurements() : s.setShowMeasurements?.(true); } })()

steps.name: assert-upper-storey-room-labels
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dim-room-name')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!labels.length) throw new Error('no dimension room labels rendered at all'); for (const need of ['Sleeping Loft','Dressing','Stair Landing']) { if(!labels.includes(need)) throw new Error('the measurement overlay omits the upstairs room "'+need+'" — it iterated plan.rooms (ground only). Got: '+labels.join(' | ')); } window.__dimLabels=labels.join(' | '); })()
